title: Prime Intellect's New MoE Kernel Speeds Qwen3 Model Training by Up to 55%
summary:
Prime Intellect has released Prime Mega MoE, a tool that optimizes the training of large-scale Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) AI models. The company reports that the new kernel accelerates training steps for the Qwen3-235B-A22B model by 55% and the Qwen3-30B-A3B model by 48% when compared to the TorchTitan framework.

The software achieves these gains by fusing computation and communication within the MoE layer through the addition of a backward kernel to the original DeepSeek Mega MoE design. In internal tests against its own prime-rl baseline, Prime Intellect found the MoE layer's forward pass to be as much as 3.11x faster. The kernel is compatible with Nvidia's Blackwell and Hopper GPU architectures.

Introducing Prime Mega MoE.

We made DeepSeek's Mega MoE kernel trainable. The results on two Qwen3 models:

• Up to 55% faster MoE training than TorchTitan

• Training steps on Qwen3-30B-A3B are 48% faster

selectedTweets.text:
Comparing the time per MoE layer between Prime Mega MoE and our prime-rl baseline:

• The forward pass is up to 3.11× faster
• The backward pass is up to 1.87× faster
• The full layer with activation checkpointing is up to 2.47× faster https://t.co/uuy0VJKqO5
